history.period: Visits of the Sikh Gurus in the 17th century; present building date unpublished
history.summary: FLAG - NOT A HINDU TEMPLE: Gurdwara Sri Khichri Sahib is a Sikh gurdwara - keep-or-drop decision needed. Per worldgurudwaras.com, it stands in village Balbhera (Balbera) of Patiala district: when Guru Hargobind Sahib came to Karhali and cured a man of leprosy, an old lady who arrived too late followed him here and offered him food; the Guru blessed the spot, saying whoever offers khichri (porridge) here would be cured of jaundice. Guru Tegh Bahadur also stopped here on his way to Delhi (toward Cheeka). CSV town correction: the CSV says 'Patiala' town, but the gurdwara is in the village of Balbhera/Balbera in Patiala district, roughly 20 km from Patiala city - not in Patiala town. Coordinates are for the village area and are approximate (flag).
